shared_elements: low-relief carving with raised outlines against a flat ground
zigzag or chevron band of pattern
justification: Both surfaces use flat low relief with raised contour lines, and both include a disc-like circular element and a band of angular zigzag/chevron pattern, but these are generic devices. A shows a single large human head and shoulder in profile with a hooked nose and a fan of parallel diagonal lines, whereas B shows a stacked, register-based assembly of multiple animals (quadrupeds, a bird, a snake-like form) with a row of crouching figures at the top — quite different subject matter and organisation.
